exposure.needed: whether operators invoke `flux push artifact --provider azure` on Azure DevOps runners (usage of the CLI in CI, not carried by any chart/manifest configuration)

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, `flux push artifact --provider azure` on DevOps runners performs Azure CLI calls that it previously did not allow, changing the command's credential behaviour in that environment.
consequence.remediation: If you run `flux push artifact --provider azure` on Azure DevOps runners, upgrade the flux CLI and verify the push authenticates as expected.

assertion.statement: The flux CLI release v2.7.0 now allows Azure CLI calls in `flux push artifact --provider azure` on DevOps runners, changing that command's authentication behaviour in that environment.
